{
 "path": "programs/task-f0af59cc.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Find every zero-background translation of the marked pattern and recolor it."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    # ARC background is the most frequent non-zero color; the marked pattern
    # uses the remaining rare color(s).
    nonzero = [(n, c) for c, n in counts.items() if c != 0]
    bg = max(nonzero)[1]
    marked = [(r, c, v) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              for v in [grid[r][c]] if v not in (0, bg)]
    if not marked:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mr, mc = min(r for r, c, v in marked), min(c for r, c, v in marked)
    pattern = [(r - mr, c - mc, v) for r, c, v in marked]
    ph = max(r for r, c, v in pattern) + 1
    pw = max(c for r, c, v in pattern) + 1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(h - ph + 1):
        for dc in range(w - pw + 1):
            cells = [(dr + r, dc + c) for r, c, v in pattern]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in cells):
                for (r, c), (_, _, color) in zip(cells, pattern):
                    out[r][c] = color
    return out
"
}
